articles.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
articles.description: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

articles.title: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
articles.description: Watch OpenAI’s Stacey Wang and Craig Bruney, Mary O’Carroll of LECG, and Cooley’s Richard Segal explore how AI can help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows and get more from outside counsel.

articles.title: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
articles.description: Richpanel uses GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol to equip its AI support agents with tools and procedures, and GPT-6 Luna for their conversations.

articles.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
articles.description: How perplexity measures progress in AI models, and why it could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities.

articles.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
articles.description: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.

articles.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
articles.description: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.

articles.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
articles.description: MedChemBench evaluates how well AI models interpret molecular structures, reason from experimental evidence, and select compounds in early drug discovery.

articles.title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
articles.description: Learn how OpenAI built the Performance Factory, a system of Codex-powered workflows that finds and fixes performance issues to help keep ChatGPT fast.

articles.title: The Silent Consensus
articles.description: Dean Ball, Head of Strategic Futures at OpenAI, examines how more capable AI could reshape society and how people can retain control of their institutions.

articles.title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
articles.description: OpenAI measures how coding agents are accelerating AI research, where their performance remains uneven, and what this signals about recursive self-improvement.
